people.name: Miguel Primo de Rivera y Orbaneja
people.nameZh: 米格爾·普里莫·德里維拉

body.zh-Hant: 據《現代歐洲百科》，普里莫·德里維拉出身於有地產與軍職背景的貴族家庭，1884年追隨父親與叔父從軍，進入將軍軍事學院。1890年代他在西屬北非、古巴與菲律賓作戰，到1908年已升至上校。
body.en: According to the Encyclopedia of Modern Europe, Primo de Rivera came from an aristocratic family with landholding and military antecedents, and in 1884 followed his father and uncle into the military by enrolling in the General Military Academy. In the 1890s he saw combat in Spanish North Africa, Cuba and the Philippines, and by 1908 he had reached the rank of colonel.

citations.quote: to an aristocratic family with landholding and military antecedents
In 1884 he followed his father and uncle into the military
enrolling in the General Military Academy
During the 1890s he experienced combat
he experienced combat in Spanish North Africa, Cuba, and the Philippines
By 1908 he attained the rank of colonel

heading.zh-Hant: 總督、參議員與軍區司令

body.zh-Hant: 1915年他轉回西班牙本土，被任命為加的斯軍事總督；1919年晉升中將。挪威《大百科》另稱，他在1920年當選加的斯選區的參議員，1922年出任加泰隆尼亞的軍區司令（generalkaptein）。
body.en: In 1915 he transferred back to Spain and was appointed military governor of Cadiz, and in 1919 he was promoted to lieutenant general. Store norske leksikon adds that in 1920 he was elected senator for Cádiz and in 1922 became captain general (generalkaptein) of Catalonia.

citations.quote: In 1915 he transferred back to Spain
being appointed military governor of Cadiz
In 1919 he was promoted to lieutenant general
I 1920 ble han valgt til senator fra Cádiz
i 1922 generalkaptein for Catalonia

heading.en: The 1923 coup and the Military Directory

body.zh-Hant: 1923年9月13日他發表致國家與軍隊的宣言；9月15日，阿方索十三世把政治權力交給他，使他成為西班牙第一位軍事獨裁者。他的軍事執政團（Military Directory）一直統治到1925年12月4日，才由文官內閣取代。挪威《大百科》稱1925年他獲得首相頭銜，所組政府也納入文官成員。
body.en: On 13 September 1923 he issued a manifesto to the country and the army, and on 15 September Alfonso XIII handed him political power as Spain's first military dictator. His Military Directory governed Spain until 4 December 1925, when it was replaced by a civilian ministry. Store norske leksikon adds that in 1925 he received the title of prime minister and appointed a government that also had civilian members.

citations.quote: On 13 September 1923 he issued a manifesto "to the country and the army"
On 15 September 1923 Alfonso XIII handed him political power
handed him political power as Spain's first military dictator
Military Directory, which continued to govern Spain until 4 December 1925
when it was replaced by a civilian ministry
I 1925 fikk han tittelen statsminister
utpekte en regjering som også hadde sivile medlemmer

body.zh-Hant: 1927年10月，政權成立一個非選舉產生的國民議會，企圖使體制制度化。1930年1月他向各軍區司令探詢支持，卻發現支持很少；他於1月28日辭職、流亡法國，3月16日在巴黎去世。
body.en: In October 1927 the regime set up a nonelective National Assembly in an attempt to institutionalize itself. In January 1930 he canvassed the captain generals for support and found little backing; he resigned on 28 January 1930, went into exile in France, and died in Paris on 16 March 1930.

citations.quote: establishing a nonelective National Assembly in October 1927
A failed effort was made to institutionalize the regime
canvassed the captain generals to gauge their support for his regime
he found little backing
In January 1930, when Primo de Rivera canvassed the captain generals
he resigned on 28 January 1930, exiled himself to France
died in Paris on 16 March 1930

body.zh-Hant: 1941年4月2日，攝政阿卜杜勒-伊拉前往美國公使館尋求庇護；美國駐伊拉克公使納巴舒（Knabenshue）電報稱，他事前得知四名軍方領袖將迫使首相辭職並讓拉希德·阿里·蓋拉尼復任。公使隨後把他載往英軍的哈巴尼亞空軍基地。4月3日電報又稱，軍方已成立新的「國防政府」，攝政當天被飛送往巴斯拉。
body.en: On 2 April 1941 the Regent, Abd al-Ilah, came to the American legation seeking refuge; the US Minister Resident in Iraq, Knabenshue, cabled that he had been forewarned that four army leaders would force the Prime Minister's resignation and reinstate Rashid Ali Gailani. The Minister then took him to the British air base at Habbaniya. A cable of 3 April added that the military had set up a new 'national defense government' and that the Regent was being flown that day from Habbaniya to Basra.

citations.quote: The Minister Resident in Iraq ( Knabenshue ) to the Secretary of State
Baghdad , April 2, 1941—7 p.m.

heading.en: Dismissed from the regency by Parliament

body.zh-Hant: 4月6日的電報稱攝政已在巴斯拉的一艘英國巡洋艦上，他另組憲政政府的嘗試已告失敗。4月10日，伊拉克議會投票免去「阿卜杜拉（Abdullah）〔即 Abdul Ilah〕」的攝政職務，另選謝里夫·沙拉夫（Al-Sharif Sharaf）為攝政；括號內的人名對應為 FRUS 編者所加。
body.en: A cable of 6 April reported the Regent aboard a British cruiser at Basra and his attempt to form a new constitutional government collapsed. On 10 April the Iraqi Parliament voted the dismissal of 'Abdullah [Abdul Ilah]' from the regency and elected Al-Sharif Sharaf as Regent; the bracketed identification was added by the FRUS editors.

citations.quote: Baghdad , April 6, 1941—6 p.m.
Regent now aboard British cruiser at Basra
attempt of Regent to establish new constitutional government has collapsed
Baghdad , April 10, 1941—7 p.m.
Iraqi Parliament today voted dismissal of Abdullah
from the Regency and elected Al-Sharif Sharaf as Regent

body.zh-Hant: 1941年6月1日，美國公使電報稱阿卜杜勒-伊拉當天返抵巴格達並恢復攝政。伊拉克軍政官員與顯要，連同英國大使與美國公使，在城外數英里處迎接他，並陪他乘車回到宮中；電報並說新政府將於當晚組成。
body.en: On 1 June 1941 the US Minister cabled that Abdul Illah returned to Baghdad that day and resumed the regency. Senior Iraqi military and civil officials and notables, together with the British Ambassador and the American Minister, met him several miles outside Baghdad and drove with him to his palace; the cable added that a new government would be formed that night.

citations.quote: Baghdad , June 1, 1941
Abdul Illah returned Baghdad today and resumed regency
Senior Iraq military and civil officials and notables
and British Ambassador and myself met him several miles outside Baghdad
drove with him to his palace
New government will be formed tonight

heading.en: The 1945 visit to the United States

body.zh-Hant: FRUS 1945年編者說明稱，1945年3月羅斯福總統邀請攝政阿卜杜勒-伊拉訪美；行程原定4月19日抵達，但羅斯福於4月12日去世，訪問因而中止。杜魯門總統於5月下旬再邀請，攝政接受；攝政與杜魯門並於6月27日與7月8日互致訊息。
body.en: The FRUS 1945 editorial note says that in March 1945 President Roosevelt invited the Regent, Abdul Ilah, to the United States and that arrangements were completed for him to arrive on 19 April, but Roosevelt's death on 12 April suspended the visit. President Truman invited the Regent to visit late in May and the invitation was accepted; the Regent and Truman exchanged messages on 27 June and 8 July.

body.zh-Hant: 據《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科》，克勞迪奧·威利曼生於1863年9月2日；1888年取得法學學位後，他在共和國大學教授數學與物理課程。共和國大學的人物頁也記載他1888年取得法學博士（Doctor en Jurisprudencia），並曾教授物理。
body.en: According to the Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture, Claudio Williman was born on 2 September 1863; after graduating in law in 1888 he taught mathematics and physics courses at the University of the Republic. The university's biographical page likewise records that he took his doctorate in jurisprudence in 1888 and taught physics.

citations.quote: b. 2 September 1863; d. 9 February 1934
After graduating with a degree in law in 1888
taught courses in mathematics and physics at the University of the Republic
Se graduó de Doctor en Jurisprudencia en 1888
fue profesor de Física en varios niveles, incluido el universitario

heading.en: University rector and minister of government

body.zh-Hant: 威利曼自1902年起擔任共和國大學校長。1904年至1907年間，他在荷西·巴特列·奧多涅斯總統的政府中任政府部長（Ministro de Gobierno）；美國駐蒙特維多公使1907年3月6日的公函也提及他曾任政府部長。
body.en: Williman served as rector of the University of the Republic from 1902. Between 1904 and 1907 he was minister of government (Ministro de Gobierno) in the administration of President José Batlle y Ordóñez; the US minister in Montevideo likewise referred to his time as minister of government in a despatch of 6 March 1907.

citations.quote: From 1902 to 1924 he served as rector of the university
Rector de la Universidad en los perídos 1902-1904 y 1912-1916
Between 1904 and 1907, he served as minister of government
in the administration of President José Batlle y Ordóñez
American Legation , Montevideo , March 6, 1907
as minister of government, I enjoyed very pleasant relations

body.zh-Hant: 科羅拉多黨提名他為總統候選人，他當選後於1907年至1911年任職。美國公使館1907年3月6日的公函附件稱，烏拉圭外交部通知，威利曼已於1907年3月1日在大會面前依憲法宣誓並接掌國家最高指揮權。《百科》稱他的政府以謹慎與嚴控公共開支為特色，與巴特列的政府相比常被視為保守。
body.en: The Colorado Party nominated him as its presidential candidate; he won the election and served from 1907 to 1911. An enclosure to a US legation despatch of 6 March 1907 relays the Uruguayan foreign office's note that Williman took possession of the supreme command of the State on 1 March 1907 after taking the constitutional oath before the General Assembly. The encyclopedia says his administration was characterized by meticulousness and strict control of public spending and is often considered conservative compared with Batlle's.

body.zh-Hant: 共和國大學的人物頁記載，他在1907年向國會提出大學新組織法草案。《百科》稱，威利曼任內巴特列留在歐洲；1910年巴特列返回烏拉圭，接任科羅拉多黨領袖，1911年繼威利曼出任總統。
body.en: The university's biographical page records that in 1907 he submitted to Parliament a new draft organic law for the University. The encyclopedia says that throughout his administration Batlle stayed in Europe, returned to Uruguay in 1910 to take up the leadership of the Colorado Party, and in 1911 succeeded Williman as president.
